name: hdrpsol_main
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %HDRPSOL: the rail-pressure setpoint. Picks one of the six KFPRSOL* 8x8 u16 maps (0x5D5224 KH / 0x5D52A4 SCH / 0x5D5324 HOM / 0x5D53A4 HMM / 0x5D54A4 HKS, offset 0x5D5424) on the shared axes 0x5D5578 (load 0x803508) and 0x5D558A (nmot), clamps to KLPRMAX (0x5D5546 = 22000 = 110.0 bar) and PRSOLMN (0x5D5572 = 7000 = 35.0 bar), then rate-limits with the spare pump volume before writing prsoll 0x8031F4. Called once from 0x45CC08. re/findings/rail.md section 3

name: hdr_pi_controller
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %HDR: prdiff = prsoll(0x8031F4) - prist(0x8031DA) -> 0x8031CA; P gain KLGPHDR (0x5D51C0), I gain KLBIHDR (0x5D51DE), both over prdiff and scaled by an nmot factor; integrator enabled only while every bit of 0x7FD2F4 is set. Output 0x8031CC, converted to a volume in 0x8031D2, which %AMSV adds to the feed-forward. Called once from 0x45CC0C. re/findings/rail.md section 4

name: hdrpist_select
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %HDRPIST: cross-checks the fast rail-pressure path (0x8031DE = 0x803438/5 - 0x5D5216) against the averaged one (0x80202E) with the threshold 0x5D5218 = 400 (2.0 bar) and hysteresis 0x5D521A = 300; publishes prist_w 0x8031DA as the fast value, a PT1 of the averaged value, or the substitute 0x80201A when the fault bit 0x80201E & 0x10 is set. Called once from 0x45CC04. re/findings/rail.md section 6

name: ggdskv_sensor
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %GGDSKV: averages the rail-pressure ADC into 0x802030, converts it with the 3-point linear sensor curve 0x5D518A (ADC 1632 = 0 -> 16384 = 31120, i.e. a 0.5/4.5 V ratiometric sensor with roughly 138 bar full scale at 0.005 bar/LSB) and adds the offset adaptation 0x800EE8>>7 -> 0x80202E. Called from 0x45CC00 and 0x430E24. re/findings/rail.md section 2c and 6

name: vstmsv_main
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %VSTMSV: MSV feed-forward and the rail model. kaparail_w 0x8031FE from KFKAPAKR (0x5D5628) over (0x7FD2FA, pressure 0x803202); volume demand 0x803200 from the fuel mass 0x80303A; steady-state pump volume 0x803212 through KFVSTVG/KFVSTVO (0x5D574A / 0x5D57AA); transient term 0x803206; total feed-forward 0x80320A. Called once from 0x45CC10. re/findings/rail.md section 4.4

name: amsv_main
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %AMSV: MSV drive. v = feed-forward 0x80320A + HDR output 0x8031D2 (CWAMSV 0x5D49CC bit 0, set); scaled into 0x80316C and clamped by the PUMP VOLUME LIMIT VMSVMX (0x5D4BC6 = 5000) -> 0x80316E; the angle curve KLDWMSV (0x5D4B44) turns that into the MSV angles 0x803164 / 0x803168. Also sets the HDR anti-windup bit 0x7FD2D9 bit 1. Called once from 0x45CC18. re/findings/rail.md section 5

name: awea_angles
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %AWEA, time-synchronous part: the start-of-injection angle wbho1s 0x803078 from KFWBHO1SW (0x5D3A83) / KFWBHO1SWE (0x5D3A33) plus KFDWBHO1SK (0x5D3971), all u8 at 0.75 degCA per count on the 0x2300 = 210.0 degCA base; the window margin 0x7FD290 (= 67 = 50.25 degCA) from KLWBHO1SMX (0x5D3BF6); and the window-derived relative-charge limit 0x803070, which is 0xFFFF unless the fuel fault bit 0x80201E & 0x20 is set. Called once from 0x45CCE8. re/findings/rail.md sections 9 and 10

name: rl_limit_min_awea
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). 0x80235A = min(0x80234C, 0x803070, 0x802358, 0x802360, 0x80235E): the arbitration that carries the injection-window charge limit into the torque structure. VCDS measuring id 2051 (format 0x21, the rl format). No bl reaches it; it is dispatched through the process-pointer table at file 0x0B1F0C. re/findings/rail.md section 10

name: rl_limit_charge_protect
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). Produces the charge-protection limits 0x80234C and 0x80234E that rl_limit_min_awea mins against the injection-window limit. re/findings/rail.md section 10

name: mul_div_sat
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). min(a*b/c, 0xFFFF); returns 0xFFFF when c == 0. Used by the prsoll rate limiter (0x45852C) and %VSTMSV

name: div32_sat_u16
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). min(((hi<<16)|lo)/div, 0xFFFF); 0xFFFF when div == 0. The callers split a 32-bit product across hi/lo, so it is a saturating 32/16 divide

name: mul_shr15_sat
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). min((a*b)>>15, 0xFFFF)

name: prsoll_w
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC for the use, COMMUNITY for the name (B9, issue #17). u16 rail-pressure setpoint, 1 LSB = 0.005 bar. Written only by hdrpsol_main (0x45872C). VCDS measuring id 501. re/findings/rail.md section 3.5

name: prdiff_w
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). s16 = prsoll - prist, 1 LSB = 0.005 bar, the input of both HDR gain curves. VCDS measuring id 1691

name: prsoll_raw
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 KFPRSOL* map output before KLPRMAX, the floor and the rate limiter

name: prsoll_lim
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 setpoint after the KLPRMAX ceiling (22000) and the PRSOLMN floor (7000), before the rate limiter

name: prsoll_ratelim
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 setpoint after the pump-volume rate limit: clamp(prsoll_lim, prev - 0x8031E6, prev + 0x8031E8)

name: vhdp_spare
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 spare pump volume = (VHDPMX 25120 - vhdp_dem 0x803212) * 0.1; zero means the pump is at its limit. Sets the UP rate of prsoll

name: vhdp_dem
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 steady-state pump volume demand from %VSTMSV; subtracted from VHDPMX to give the spare volume

name: kaparail_w
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 rail/fuel compressibility from KFKAPAKR (0x5D5628); the volume-per-bar factor of both the setpoint rate limiter and the HDR output conversion

name: hdr_vol_out
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). s16 HDR controller output converted into a volume; %AMSV adds it to the feed-forward 0x80320A. VCDS measuring id 1687

name: hdrr_w
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). s16 sum of the HDR P and I branches. VCDS measuring id 516

name: vmsv_limited
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 MSV volume request after the pump volume limit VMSVMX (0x5D4BC6 = 5000). Pinned at 5000 means the pump is saturated - the single best log signal for a flex-fuel rail raise

name: vmsv_dem
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 total MSV volume demand (feed-forward + HDR output) before the limit

name: dwmsvs_w
comment: HYPOTHESIS for the name, VERIFIED-STATIC for the use (B9, issue #17). s16 MSV switch-off angle written by amsv_main

name: dwmsvo_w
comment: HYPOTHESIS for the name, VERIFIED-STATIC for the use (B9, issue #17). s16 MSV switch-on angle written by amsv_main

name: fuel_fault_bits
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 fuel-system fault byte written by the rail-pressure diagnosis at 0x0F3148 / 0x0F3264 / 0x0F33B0. bit 4 = sensor fault (prist falls back to 0x80201A), bit 5 = bit2|bit6 built at 0x0F3338-0x0F3350 and the ONLY thing that arms the injection-window charge limit 0x803070. re/findings/rail.md section 10

name: rl_max_window
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 relative-charge limit derived from the available injection window: ((0x7FD28F - 0x7FD290 + 280) * 13) << 15 / k_nmot, or 0xFFFF when 0x80201E & 0x20 is clear. Limp-home only. re/findings/rail.md section 10

name: rl_max_arb
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 min(0x80234C, rl_max_window, 0x802358, 0x802360, 0x80235E), computed at 0x0C7CF8. VCDS measuring id 2051. Feeds the final charge limit 0x80360E

name: rl_max_final
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 final permitted relative charge, read by the torque structure / throttle path at 0x42AA0C, 0x42AA60, 0x435B48 and 0x0E8B10

name: wbho1s_w
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). s16 start-of-injection angle actually used, 1 LSB = 3/128 degCA. awea_ti_to_angle advances it when wbho1s - dwi <= 0x7FD290*32 (50.25 degCA) and caps it at 0x7FD28F*32 + 0x2300 (360.0 degCA). Log it against dwi 0x803088. re/findings/rail.md section 9.3

name: wbho1s_set
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). s16 start-of-injection angle setpoint from KFWBHO1SW/KFWBHO1SWE, written by awea_angles

name: k_nmot_angle
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 = (nmot_w * 34360) >> 16 = rpm * 2.0971680, written at 0x41B9B8 and 0x41BD90. dwi = (ti * k_nmot) >> 13. With the angle LSB 3/128 degCA this forces ti = 1 us per LSB. re/findings/rail.md section 8

name: dwbho1smn_w
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 required end-of-injection margin from KLWBHO1SMX (0x5D3BF6); 67 = 50.25 degCA in this dataset. The threshold of the injection-window check

name: wbho1smx_w
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 latest permitted start of injection from the curve 0x5D3BE2; 200 = 150 degCA above the 0x2300 base = 360.0 degCA. Init default 0xC8 at 0x131250

name: prist_ratio
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 = min((prist*2)<<16 / 0x7FEFAE, 0xFFFF), the axis input of KLWBHO1SMX

name: b_wbh_invalid
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 flag set by awea_angles when prist > PRWBHMX (0x5D3CDC = 2600 = 13.0 bar); gates the injection-window model

name: hdr_enable_bits
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 enable set of the HDR integrator: bit1 actuator not on its limit, bit2 sensor OK, bit3/bit4 operating windows, bit5 nmot in 1500..3500 min^-1, bit6 setpoint settled, bit7 temperature gate

name: KFPRSOLHOM
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). 8x8 u16 homogeneous rail-pressure setpoint map, rows = nmot (axis 0x5D558A), columns = load (axis 0x5D5578), 1 LSB = 0.005 bar: 7000..19000 = 35..95 bar. The primary target of a flex-fuel rail raise. re/findings/rail.md section 3.2

name: KFPRSOLSCH
comment: HYPOTHESIS for the FR name, VERIFIED-STATIC for the rest (B9, issue #17). 8x8 u16 setpoint map selected by 0x7FB69A bit 1, 10000..20000 = 50..100 bar

name: KFPRSOLKH
comment: HYPOTHESIS for the FR name, VERIFIED-STATIC for the rest (B9, issue #17). 8x8 u16 setpoint map selected by 0x7FB69A bit 7, 7000..19000 = 35..95 bar

name: KFPRSOLHMM
comment: HYPOTHESIS for the FR name, VERIFIED-STATIC for the rest (B9, issue #17). 8x8 u16 setpoint map selected by 0x7FB69A bit 4 / bit 2 / 0x80156F bit 0, 12000..19000 = 60..95 bar

name: KFPRSOLHKS
comment: HYPOTHESIS for the FR name, VERIFIED-STATIC for the rest (B9, issue #17). 8x8 u16 setpoint map selected by 0x7FB69A bit 3, 12000..20000 = 60..100 bar

name: KFPRSOLOFF
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). 8x8 u16 additive setpoint offset, 0..5000 = 0..+25 bar, summed into KFPRSOLHOM and KFPRSOLHKS because CWPRSOL (0x5D521E) bit 5 is set; weighted by the 6-point s8 curve 0x5D5559 over a temperature. The cheapest code-free hook for an E-blend-dependent rail raise

name: axis_prsol_load
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u16 n=8; u16 axis[8]} = 0, 6554, 13107, 19661, 26214, 39322, 52429, 65535 - 0/10/20/30/40/60/80/100 % of a 16-bit full scale. Column axis of every KFPRSOL* map; input 0x803508 from the torque structure

name: axis_prsol_nmot
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u16 n=8; u16 axis[8]} = 3000, 5000, 8000, 10000, 14000, 18000, 22800, 24800 = 750..6200 min^-1. Row axis of every KFPRSOL* map

name: KLPRMAX
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). Six u16, ALL 22000 = 110.0 bar: the rail-pressure setpoint ceiling, over the u8 axis 0x5D553F. The single constant that caps any flex-fuel rail raise; 110 bar is the published VW maximum, which is what fixes the 0.005 bar/LSB scaling. re/findings/rail.md section 2a

name: PRSOLMN
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 = 7000 = 35.0 bar, the setpoint floor

name: CWPRSOL
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 = 0x2E. bit0 fixed setpoint (clear), bit3 track prist while starting (set), bit4 use the filtered setpoint (clear), bit5 add KFPRSOLOFF (set)

name: VHDPMX
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 = 25120, the maximum pump delivery. VHDPMX - vhdp_dem is the spare volume that sets the UP rate limit of prsoll - the pump volume limit in its rate-limiting role. re/findings/rail.md section 3.4

name: VMSVMX
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 = 5000, the MSV volume clamp in %AMSV: 0x80316E = min(0x80316C, 5000). The hard pump delivery limit per stroke

name: KLBIHDR
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u16 n=7; s16 axis[7] @0x5D51E0; u16 val[7] @0x5D51EE}: HDR I gain over prdiff

name: KLDSKV_sensor
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u16 n=3; u16 axis[3]; u16 val[3]} rail-pressure sensor characteristic: ADC 1632, 5899, 16384 -> 0, 9000, 31120, one straight line. ADC 16384 = 5.000 V, so zero pressure sits at 0.498 V: a 0.5/4.5 V ratiometric sensor with about 138 bar full scale at 0.005 bar/LSB. re/findings/rail.md section 2c

name: KFKAPAKR
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). 10x10 u16 fuel/rail compressibility map over (0x7FD2FA, rail pressure), axes 0x5D560A and 0x5D5614. Result kaparail_w 0x8031FE

name: KLDWMSV
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). 35 x s16 volume -> MSV closing angle over the u16 axis 0x5D4AFE; result 0x803166, clamped to 0..1100

name: CWAMSV
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 = 0xD3. bit0 = add the HDR controller output to the MSV feed-forward (SET, so the loop is closed); bit5 = fixed volume (clear)

name: KFWBHO1SW
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). 8 columns (rl axis 0x5C88DB) x 10 rows (nmot axis 0x5C88A8) u8 start-of-injection angle, 0.75 degCA per count plus the 0x2300 = 210.0 degCA base: 210..330 degCA. re/findings/rail.md section 9.2

name: KFWBHO1SWE
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). The second 8x10 u8 start-of-injection map, same axes, selected when 0x7FD419 <= 25 (u8 @ 0x5D3970): 80..240 counts = 270..390 degCA

name: KFDWBHO1SK
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). 8x10 s8 correction added to the start-of-injection angle as (map * 0x7FD28E) >> 3; -64..0 counts = -48..0 degCA

name: axis_awea_nmot
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u8 n=10; u8 axis[10]} = 19, 25, 38, 50, 63, 75, 88, 100, 125, 155 = about 760..6200 min^-1 (40 min^-1 per LSB). Row axis of the three %AWEA angle maps; searched once at 0x115C08, key in 0x7FD804

name: axis_awea_rl
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u8 n=8; u8 axis[8]} = 13, 27, 40, 53, 67, 80, 93, 107 over the u8 relative charge 0x7FEF74. Column axis of the three %AWEA angle maps; searched once at 0x115C18, key in 0x7FD83C

name: KLWBHO1SMX
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u8 n=6; u16 axis[6] @0x5D3BEA; u8 val[6] @0x5D3BF6} = ALL 67 = 50.25 degCA: the required margin between the end of injection and the window reference. Result 0x7FD290, the threshold of the injection-window check. re/findings/rail.md section 9.1

name: KLWBHO1SLT
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). {u8 n=6; u8 axis[6]; u8 val[6] @0x5D3BE2} = ALL 200 = 150 degCA above the 0x2300 base, i.e. 360.0 degCA: the latest permitted start of injection. Result 0x7FD28F

name: KVWBHRL
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u8 = 13, converts the available injection window into the relative-charge limit 0x803070. re/findings/rail.md section 10

name: PRWBHMX
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16 = 2600 = 13.0 bar; prist above it sets 0x7FEA48 and invalidates the injection-window model

name: esausg_output
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). %ESAUSG: the injection output stage. Converts the per-cylinder start angles 0x80309C[6] / 0x8030A8[6] against the reference array tbl_cyl_ref_angle (0x409CA0) with a mod-0x7800 wrap, scales by 15/64 into the TPU unit of 0.1 degCA and calls the drivers through the function pointers 0x7FCDC8 / 0x7FCDCC. It also programs the HARD INJECTION CUT-OFF angle (reference - 0x7FD290*0x20 = 50.25 degCA) and passes b_wbh_invalid == 0 as the enable - so the cut-off is armed only while rail pressure is at or below PRWBHMX (13.0 bar). re/findings/rail.md section 14

name: tbl_cyl_ref_angle
comment: VERIFIED-STATIC (B9, issue #17). u16[6] = 3072, 8192, 13312, 18432, 23552, 28672 = 72, 192, 312, 432, 552, 672 degCA at 3/128 degCA per LSB - the six per-cylinder reference angles, spaced exactly 120 degCA. Together with the mod-0x7800 (= 720 degCA) wrap in esausg_output this is the proof of the angle unit and hence of ti = 1 us per LSB. re/findings/rail.md section 14.1
